describes: The Coach's per-pulse output (Stage 2 of the W4 pipeline). Presentation-generic: generic semantic tokens the Renderer resolves to pixels. No class-specific tokens, no resolved RGBA (one exception: powerType).
supersedes: The five-channel Stage-2 sketch in docs/architecture.md. chrome + per-cue role + the effects channel + a separate Theme layer are cut/deferred for v1.

principle.rule: A cue attribute is a GENERIC SEMANTIC TOKEN -- class-agnostic AND display-agnostic. The Renderer owns token -> pixels (built into the Renderer for v1; a Theme is a later refactor).

rejected.classToken: colorKey:'TYRANT' -- the View would need class knowledge.
rejected.resolvedPixels: color:[r,g,b,a] -- display-locked; the Coach shouldn't pick pixels.

exception.why: Guidance carries the game's own power token; the Renderer resolves colour via the game's PowerBarColor table. Allowed because the colour is a built-in game signal (mana blue, energy yellow, shards purple), universal across every UI -- not a Coach aesthetic. Still a token in Guidance, so the rule holds.

resourceBars.note: ARRAY of power meters (multi-spec Phase 3). One entry per power the active spec declares (spec.powers); a single-resource spec (Demonology = Soul Shards) emits a one-element array. The Renderer stacks them vertically.
resourceBars.incoming: number  // net power delta of in-flight casts, DERIVED BY THE COACH from the pulse's cast history (ns.Coach.InflightPower: a 'start' with no later 'succeeded'/'stopped' for the same base, inside a 3s flight window, x the spec's signed ns.SpecPowerDelta). Stage-1 State does NOT carry this -- roster-state-plan Phase 6 moved it out of the ingestion layer. The Coach ranks on projected = value + incoming, and DecisionLog's PW field reads it from HERE.
resourceBars.unitsNote: TWO UNITS, DELIBERATELY (Phase 6.2). value/max/incoming are in DISPLAY units (Soul Shards: 0-5) BECAUSE THE RENDERER DRAWS ONE PIP PER UNIT OF `max` (Renderer.lua drawResourceRow pools one texture per unit and fills the first `value`) -- a max of 50 would try to draw fifty pips. The fields below carry the EXACT rail alongside, additively.
resourceBars.valueExact: number | ABSENT  // the power in the game's INTERNAL units (Soul Shards: 0-50 fragments), from State's UnitPower(unit, type, unmodified) read. An INTEGER, never a pre-divided float: dividing is the consumer's job, at the edge, so no boundary comparison upstream can be decided by a float. ABSENT -- never 0 -- when the client refused the exact read; 0 would read as 'you have none', a different and actionable sentence.
resourceBars.maxExact: number | ABSENT  // the exact-unit cap (Soul Shards: 50). Same absent-not-zero rule.
resourceBars.incomingExact: number | ABSENT  // the in-flight projection in the same exact units. Unlike valueExact this is OUR arithmetic, not a measurement, so it is present whenever the bar declares a projection.
resourceBars.modifier: number | ABSENT  // exact units per display unit (Soul Shards: 10; mana/energy: 1). The divisor relating the two rails, resolved live off state.power[name].modifier with the spec's declared spec.powers[].modifier as the fallback.
resourceBars.consumers: DecisionLog's PW field prefers the exact rail so it can render `PW:1.8/+0.2`; an all-integer PW column in a capture means the exact read is not wired. The other intended consumer is a partial-fill pip renderer, which does not exist yet -- see docs/status.md backlog 'Partial-shard pip rendering'. resourceDisplay is NOT touched by this: the enum stays closed.

<cooldownID>.transient: enum:transient | null  // a phase EDGE; Renderer edge-detects
<cooldownID>.note: string | null  // PASS-THROUGH display text only

sequence.title: string  // PASS-THROUGH
sequence.cursor: number  // index of the current step

emphasis.origin: HudBoard colorKey, promoted to the public contract.
emphasis.invariant_singleTopPress: Decided 2026-07-25; revised W4 Phase 8 (2026-07-27); REVISED AGAIN 2026-08-03 (the look-ahead). Exactly ONE cue holds the 'press now' emphasis -- ROTATION, or LATE when that press is overdue (they never co-occur) -- the flat priority list's first castable line. At most ONE cue holds ROTATION_FALLBACK, which since 2026-08-03 means THE NEXT PRESS rather than the runner-up: the same cascade re-ranked over ns.Coach.Advance(state, winner), i.e. the board one GCD later assuming the winner is pressed. When that lands back on the WINNER'S OWN ability no second cue is emitted -- the winner's cue carries `next = true` and the Renderer draws a small companion dot on that one icon, so the on-screen dot COUNT is unchanged and a repeat is legible as a repeat. All other ready abilities cap at AVAILABLE (internal; no cue). SOON (anticipation) and the resourceBars may coexist -- they are not 'press now' claims.

members.SOON: anticipating -- not yet pressable; dim + countdown treatment. W4 Phase 8: a DUMB per-ability 'coming off cooldown' decoration (any tracked damage cooldown anticipated within the lead), independent of the winner logic -- multiple may show at once.
members.ROTATION: press this now -- the steady lit press
members.ROTATION_FALLBACK: THE LOOK-AHEAD (2026-08-03; was 'the honest runner-up', W4 Phase 8). What the SAME priority list picks one GCD from now, assuming the player presses the winner -- ranked over ns.Coach.Advance, which starts the winner's cooldown, spends one of its charges and advances every other ability's remaining by one GCD. A sequence hint, not a 'press now' claim and no longer a hedge. At most one; coexists with the single ROTATION/LATE press. WHY IT CHANGED: the runner-up answered 'if I am wrong, press this instead', which on a fast spec is less useful than 'what to be ready for'. WHAT IT CANNOT MODEL: resources (most specs' primary resource is a Secret Value, so affordability passes through unchanged) and buffs/cast history (a press that would open a window does not flip it here) -- so it fails toward the STEADY-STATE next press. A predicted-ready cooldown carries source = 'lookahead' and may only ever reach this cue, never the press-now one.
members.LATE: overdue -- you have been sitting on it
members.JUDGE: RETIRED (W4 Phase 8). Was a judgment-call availability (Implosion off cooldown / Demonbolt Core dump). The uncertainty is now carried by offering the runner-up as a real press (ROTATION_FALLBACK), so the Coach no longer emits JUDGE. Token kept for history, like SEQUENCE.
members.SEQUENCE: RETIRED (TCT redesign). ATTENTION-REDIRECT (not a press): pointed the player at the sequence PANEL. The one-press cue walk replaced the panel, so no cue emits it. Token kept for a possible future additive planner. (was BURST)
members.next: A BOOLEAN FLAG on a cue (not an emphasis token): the look-ahead landed back on this same ability, i.e. press it twice. Renders as a small companion dot beside the cue dot, in the cue's own colour. Set only on the ROTATION/LATE cue, and only when nextKey == winnerKey.

internal.AVAILABLE: off cooldown but not a call -- no cue

emphasis.open: SEQUENCE's exact Renderer treatment (arrow/glow toward the panel, how loud) is DEFERRED -- a Renderer decision, not a contract one; not settled while there is no Renderer.

transient.semantics: A phase EDGE the Renderer edge-detects: fire on the transition INTO the value, do NOT re-fire while it persists; clears to null. Idempotent under re-applied Guidance.

members.cast_started: a cast on this ability committed / is in flight
members.ready: the ability's cooldown just came up
members.proc: a proc that empowers this ability just lit

members.done: already cast this run of the sequence
members.blocked: upcoming but gated (e.g. needs a resource) -- see the step note

powerType.kind: Pass-through of the game's Enum.PowerType token (e.g. SOUL_SHARDS).

members.discrete: whole segments (soul shards). The Destruction draft calls this 'segmented' -- treat that as a synonym for 'discrete', NOT a separate enum member (avoid enum drift).
members.continuous: a continuous fill (e.g. an energy/mana bar). Added multi-spec Phase 3 for the full resource seam; the Renderer's pixel path is a Phase-when-needed STUB (a continuous bar currently draws nothing) -- no live consumer yet.
members.none: TRACKED BUT NOT DRAWN. Added 2026-08-02 for the Paladin/DH specs, whose resources (Holy Power, Fury) the brain decides on but the HUD deliberately does not render. The entry is a FULL resourceBars member -- it carries value/max/incoming and the exact rail, DecisionLog's PW column reads it, the Coach ranks on it -- and the Renderer skips it. This is why it is a display member and not an empty spec.powers: an empty powers array emits NO resourceBars entry, so PW: would render `?/?` and the primary instrument for debugging a brain nobody can watch live would go dark across five new specs. `none` keeps the data rail whole and turns off exactly one thing: pixels.

resourceDisplay.open: Enumerate additional forms as later specs need them (keep the meter renderer closed-set).
resourceDisplay.rendererPredicate: The Renderer tests `display == 'discrete'` and draws pips for THAT ALONE; every other member (and any future one) draws nothing. Until 2026-08-02 it tested `== 'continuous'` instead, so 'percentage' -- a member this contract declares valid -- fell through into the pip loop and rendered a continuous fill as segments. An unrecognised display must draw nothing, never guess.
resourceDisplay.notAddedInPhase62: Destruction's real bar is 5 segments with PARTIAL FILL (Soul Shards are 0-50 fragments), which is neither 'discrete' nor 'continuous'. Phase 6.2 shipped the exact READ and deliberately did NOT grow this enum. The old reason -- 'State cannot read the fraction' -- is spent; the remaining blocker is purely the Renderer's per-pip loop, which has no fractional path. valueExact/maxExact/modifier above are exactly what such a member would consume, so the data is already waiting. See docs/status.md backlog 'Partial-shard pip rendering'.

passthroughStrings.rule: The ONLY place class/spec vocabulary may appear -- opaque display text the Coach authored and the View prints verbatim, never interprets.

cut.chrome: mode/accent tint -- the cues out-signal a mode; build/spend stays internal Coach reasoning.
cut.role: per-cue ability group -- v1 cues colour by emphasis (urgency), not group. Drops today's group brackets (intentional).
cut.effects: the keyed effects channel -- folded into cues[].transient; no screen-level or float-text effects in v1.
cut.theme: the token->pixel table lives in the Renderer for v1; extract a Theme later if wanted -- a refactor, not a rewrite.
